complaint_text: I tried adding my bank account twice and it keeps failing verification.
My routing and account numbers are correct but the bank account will not verify.
The app keeps showing an error when I try to save my bank account.
I cannot complete bank verification even after retrying.
My bank account was added but never became available for payment.
Verification failed three times and I had to give up.
I keep getting a verification unavailable message.
The bank account setup stops at the verification step.
I removed a bank account but still see it in a previous payment confirmation.
I want to know why my newly added account is pending verification.
I cannot find where to change my default bank account.
Why do I need to verify a bank account before using it?
I tried to remove the only bank account on file and could not.
My bank account nickname did not update right away.
I added a new account and want to know when I can use it.
I do not understand which saved account will be used for my payment.
I do not see Payment Flex even though I wanted to use it.
Why was I not offered Payment Flex on my account?
The Payment Flex option is missing for me.
I expected to see an assistance offer but nothing appeared.
Why am I not eligible for Payment Flex?
My friend saw an offer but I do not see one on my account.
I do not understand why some payment dates are unavailable.
The calendar has dates disabled but does not explain why.
I kept trying different dates because the app would not tell me what was allowed.
Why can I only pick certain payment dates?
The payment date I wanted was greyed out and there was no explanation.
I tried three dates before finding one that worked.
The date selector is confusing because it does not tell me why a date cannot be selected.
I thought the app was broken because several dates were disabled.
I accepted Payment Flex but want to review the details again.
I want to know whether I can change the payment amount after accepting.
I need help understanding the confirmation screen.
I want to know when my Payment Flex payment will process.
I accepted the plan but the scheduled payment would not save.
The app failed when I tried to create my payment schedule.
I received an error after confirming my Balance Assist payment dates.
My plan setup failed at the final scheduling step.
I tried to confirm my payment schedule and received a service error.
The payment schedule failed twice before it finally worked.
I could see the plan but could not finish setting up the payments.
I had to retry several times before my schedule was created.
I want to understand how many scheduled payments are in my plan.
Can I change a scheduled payment after accepting the plan?
Why is my current balance different from the plan balance?
I want to review the dates in my existing Balance Assist Plan.
I do not understand when the next payment is due.
I need help understanding the plan confirmation.

details: Elevated bank verification failures between 09:05 and 10:20. Service recovered after dependency reset.
Residual verification retries observed after primary recovery; no ongoing outage.
Customer-experience review opened for repeated confusion around unavailable payment dates; no technical outage detected.
Elevated scheduling errors from 12:40 to 13:25 impacted plan setup.
Service recovered; retry traffic remained elevated for approximately 20 minutes.
Monitoring alert reviewed; no customer impact confirmed.
